Alert.title: Excessive Holding Duration on Furnace F2
Alert.message: Heat H-105 has been holding for 47 minutes (threshold: 30 minutes). Avoidable holding energy: ~28.3 kWh.
Alert.explainableAction: Expedite mould preparation on Line 2 or lower bath power to standby setpoint. Excessive holding increases thermal radiation losses without metallurgical value.

Alert.title: Power Factor Below Target on Furnace F2
Alert.message: Power factor 0.94 is below the target threshold of 0.95. Apparent load is 657 kVA.
Alert.explainableAction: Inspect the furnace capacitor bank and automatic power factor correction (APFC) steps. Low PF incurs DISCOM surcharge penalties and unnecessarily consumes transformer kVA capacity.

Alert.title: Demand Spike Approaching Contract Sanction
Alert.message: Current plant active demand is 1240 kW, surpassing warning threshold of 1050 kW.
Alert.explainableAction: Stagger melt start times by at least 45 minutes to prevent simultaneous full-power heating cycles. Utilize the METALLO Schedule Optimizer to automate this.

Alert.title: Melting Operation Scheduled During Peak Tariff Window
Alert.message: Heat H-101 melt cycle occurred between 06:30 and 07:30 within the morning Peak Tariff period (₹9.0/kWh).
Alert.explainableAction: Where pour commitments allow, shift melt cycles to after 10:00 to capitalize on standard or off-peak utility tariffs.

Alert.title: Sub-Optimal Power Factor (0.94) on F1
Alert.message: Power factor 0.94 is below the target threshold of 0.95. Apparent load is 649 kVA.
Alert.explainableAction: Inspect harmonic filter banks and tuning capacitors. Poor PF increases reactive kVA demand and triggers utility surcharge penalties under HT billing schedules.

Alert.title: Excessive Holding Duration on F1
